NWS Detroit/Pontiac · 729 PM EDT Thu Oct 29 2026

- There is a chance of showers and isolated thunderstorms this

- Warm conditions with humidity will be possible early to middle

&&

.AVIATION...

Departing cold front is drawing the narrow band of frontal moisture 
out of the airspace, leaving behind clear skies and veering winds. 
Stratus plume noted over the Upper Peninsula expands south through 
the overnight, and will brush the Saginaw Valley early Friday 
morning. This may initially allow MVFR restrictions to develop, 
although clears out through the morning as mixing occurs. Light 
northwest flow then prevails for the day as high cloud streams in 
from the west. 

D21/DTW Convection...Thunderstorms are not forecast through the TAF 
period.
